processing: Generated from the approved Grok 4.7 vs Fable 5.1 v9 hero as a composition reference while replacing all model-specific text, colors, and symbols
Opus uses the established cobalt, steel-blue, and ice palette with bracket-and-reasoning-plate instrumentation
Astra uses champagne gold and solar amber with a cursor-and-loop execution instrument
